met_analysis:
The upper air cyclonic circulation over North Myanmar and adjoining Mizoram-Tripura between 3.1 & 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Sikkim & neighbourhood between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over central Assam & neighbourhood now lies over northeast Assam & neighbourhood and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The trough from Northeast Arabian sea to westcentral Arabian sea now seen as cyclonic circulation over Westcentral Arabian sea between 1.5 & 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over East Uttar Pradesh & adjoining Bihar at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from West Uttar Pradesh to north Gujarat now runs from West Uttar Pradesh to Southeast Rajasthan at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Southeast Arabian sea off Keralam coast at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
A trough runs from Southeast Arabian sea to eastcentral Arabian sea off Keralam-Karnataka-Goa-Maharashtra coasts at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Southwest Bay of Bengal & adjoining Sri Lanka at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
